recipes.title: Ginger Bug
recipes.summary: Wild fermented culture: fresh ginger + sugar + water. Captures natural yeast/bacteria from ginger skin into a live starter that carbonates any sweetened liquid.
steps: Day 1: 4 cups filtered water + 2 tbsp chopped ginger + 2 tbsp sugar, stir to dissolve, into Fermenstation jar with lid.
Days 2-7: feed daily with 1 tbsp ginger + 1 tbsp sugar, stir, re-cover.
Ready when small bubbles rise on stirring (days 3-4), tangy yeasty smell, lightly sour fizzy taste.
Harvest: strain, discard old ginger, reserve 200ml per soda batch, top up jar to 1L, feed 1 tbsp each.
Rest: fridge + feed 1 tbsp each once/week. Wake: feed + 12-24h in Fermenstation before use.
recipes.warning_signs: Fuzzy mold (white/green/black/pink) or rotten smell = discard. Thin white film / cloudy liquid = normal.

soda.title: Ginger Bug Soda (ginger ale/beer)
steps: Boil 1L water, add ginger/sugar/lemon peel/spices, simmer 5 min, steep until lukewarm.
Strain bug, measure 200ml, feed the rest.
Strain tea into pitcher, add remaining 2L water + lemon juice.
Add bug liquid, pour into 4x700ml bottles, 1 inch headspace, close tight.
F2 ferment 2-3 days, burp to check carbonation.
